falseSynonyms.zh: 命名不等於 describe name 只是指出名稱；describe 要提供特徵、情況或細節。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Naming identifies; describing gives characteristics or details.

falseSynonyms.zh: 列出不等於 describe list 只是逐項列出；describe 通常還要說明每項的特徵或情況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Listing enumerates; describing explains what something is like.

falseSynonyms.zh: 定義不等於 describe define 是精確說明詞義／概念邊界；describe 可以較靈活地提供特徵。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Defining states meaning or boundaries; describing gives features.

falseSynonyms.zh: explain 和 describe 有重疊，但焦點不同 explain 回答 how/why；describe 主要回答 what something is like / what happened。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Explanation gives causes or mechanisms; description gives features or an account.

falseSynonyms.zh: 摘要不等於完整 describe summarise 只保留主要重點；describe 可以很詳細。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Summarising compresses; describing may include rich detail.

falseSynonyms.zh: 評估不等於 describe evaluate 是判斷質素／價值；describe 本身不要求作價值判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Evaluation judges quality; description can remain neutral.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提及不等於 describe mention 只是簡短提到；describe 需要更多資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Mentioning refers briefly; describing provides detail.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 describe 是動詞；description 是名詞。句子結構不能直接互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Describe is a verb; description is a noun.
